messages.name: Sign-in code by email
messages.description: The code (and, when the website asks for one, the magic link) a person uses to sign in with their email address.

email.subject: Your sign-in code for {business}

messages.name: Invitation
messages.description: Sent when staff invite someone: a link to set up their account.

email.subject: You are invited to {business}

sms.text: You are invited to {business}. Set up your account: {link} (the link works for {days} days)

messages.name: Password reset link
messages.description: Sent when someone asks to reset the password of an account that signs in with an email address.

email.subject: Reset your password for {business}
email.text:
We got a request to reset the password of your {business} account. Choose a new password with this link: {link}

The link works for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

messages.name: Code by phone
messages.description: The code a person types to sign in with their phone number, or to choose a new password (Phone + password).

sms.text: {code} is your {business} code. It expires in {minutes} minutes. Never share it with anyone.
